answer_1.quote: We evaluate on four diverse tasks from KILT: slot filling, question answering, fact checking and dialog.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answer text together with provenance passages from the knowledge source.

answer_2.quote: The metrics of R-Precision and Recall@5 measure the correctness of the provenance... Accuracy and (token-level) F1 measure the correctness of the generated output. For Wizard of Wikipedia, Rouge-L is used instead of accuracy... The metrics of KILT-Accuracy, KILT-F1 and, for Wizard of Wikipedia, KILT-Rouge-L are the underlying metric...

answer_4.quote: We examined 20 instances coupled with 3 output texts... The three output texts were presented unlabeled and in random order to avoid bias. For each instance, we read the conversation history and then mark each text either ...
answer_4.guideline: Read the conversation history and mark each generated text as consistent or inconsistent with the context.
